title: FuriusSteal
description: The Best Lifesteal Plugin.Made by Furiusfighter213
body:
FuriusSteal is an advanced Lifesteal plugin for Minecraft 1.21 – 1.21.10.
It includes a professional heart system, the unique FuriusHeart drop, fixed multilingual messages, extended configuration, and intuitive pro-level commands.
Designed to become one of the best Lifesteal plugins ever created.

⭐ Main Features
❤️ Custom Lifesteal System

Killing a player drops the FuriusHeart item.

Consuming the heart gives +1 Max Heart.

Hearts stack up to 16 per slot.

Max hearts configurable (Default: 20, Max: 40).

Minimum hearts = 1 → Player gets permanently banned.

Admins can revive banned players.

❤️ FuriusHeart Item

Custom texture (heart icon).

Custom name + glow effect.

Only drops from combat kills.

Fully configurable drop chance.

🌍 Multilingual System

Supports English & German.

Auto-detects server language.

All plugin messages start with:
FuriusSteal:

Messages cannot be changed by admins.

⚔️ Custom Death Messages

Unique messages for each death cause.

PvP, Fall, Void, Fire, Explosion, Drowning etc.

Randomized + multilingual.

🛠️ Professional Commands

Commands available in two forms:

1. Plugin style
/furius <subcommand>

2. Direct style
/heart ...
/revive ...

Heart Command Group
/heart reload
/heart give <player> <amount>
/heart take <player> <amount>
/heart set <player> <amount>

Tab Completion

/revive → Shows all permanently banned players.

/heart give/take/set → Shows all online players.

Works like vanilla /gamemode.

Commands feel natural, intuitive and professional.

⚙️ Advanced Config (config.yml)

Max/Min hearts

Absolute maximum hearts

Combat settings

Notifications

Revive options

Drop chance

Stack size

Prefix settings

Language settings
